evidence.quote: Foreign Limited Liability Company (LLC) R.I. Gen. Laws Chapter 7-16 File Online PDF $150
Instructions for Filing Application for Registration for a Foreign Limited Liability Company
State of Rhode Island Department of State - Business Services Division
The agent must be a Rhode Island resident or an entity qualified to do business in this state.

Remember, all businesses registered with the RI Department of State are responsible for paying at least the state’s minimum corporate tax ($400 or 7% of the business income, whichever is higher) to the RI Division of Taxation each tax year.
A certificate of good standing/legal existence from the state or country in which the entity is incorporated, dated within 60 days of the date of filing, must accompany most applications.

notes: The $150 fee is the registration fee only; the minimum corporate tax is a separate annual obligation. A certificate of good standing/legal existence from the home jurisdiction, dated within 60 days of filing, must accompany the application.
